question: What causes rainfall on the coastal areas of Tamil Nadu in the beginning of winters ?
solution:
The correct answer is __North-Eastern monsoon__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

Northeast monsoon:

 
• Retreating monsoon in India can be experienced in October-November.
 
• Monsoon winds are retreating gradually and the sudden rise of temperature with October heat.
 
• Day temperature is high and nights are cool and pleasant.&a
